note:
K-bucket (Kaito/InfoFi). Live PAYG x402 API (api.kaito.ai/api/payg/*): real crypto market data (sentiment/mindshare/narrative/smart_followers), per-request USDC on Base via x402 exact scheme, no API key, no Nano. Probed live 2026-09-26: GET /api/payg/sentiment -> HTTP 402, accepts eip155:8453 USDC, payTo 0xC92A... (verified). Doc repo MetaSearch-IO/KaitoX402APIDocs has issues enabled, not archived
XNO TOOLS (live 2026-10-03):
- nano-invoice: https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice — bind an XNO payment to the order it pays for (one invoice per order, unique tagged amount, a block settles one invoice, refunds to the real sender). 40 tests, live node read verified.
- dual-rail: https://github.com/dhyabi2/dual-rail — add an XNO leg BESIDE an existing USDC/x402 rail, never instead of it. 34 Python + 22 Node tests, 7/7 both-rails-live check.
- nano-finality-proof: https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-finality-proof — measure how long an XNO payment takes to confirm on a node you run, so an agent knows when a payment is final. 54 unit + 67 e2e checks.
- SailNet: https://github.com/dhyabi2/sailnet (+ site https://www.sailnet.space) — privacy network paid in XNO: run a relay and earn XNO per megabyte, or route traffic over onion circuits. Android/desktop/Chrome/Firefox, Docker on ghcr, v0.3.37+.
